arenaInfo.name: Tara Swim Arena Workout Center
arenaInfo.tagline: Elite Aquatic Training & Swim Fitness Programs

services.title: Olympic Lane Sprint Training
services.description: High-intensity interval set focusing on anaerobic threshold, explosive push-offs, and turn efficiency.

services.title: Freestyle Technique & Stroke Clinic
services.description: One-on-one stroke biomechanics correction, body rotation drills, and underwater video analysis.

services.title: Triathlon Endurance & Pace Mastery
services.description: Long-distance aerobic threshold pacing, bilateral breathing drills, and open-water simulation.

services.title: Threshold Power Kick & Pull Clinic
services.description: Resistance-based swim workout with kickboards, pull buoys, and drag chutes for upper core power.

services.title: Hydrotherapy & Recovery Cool-Down
services.description: Low-impact active recovery drills, joint decompression swimming, and guided breathwork in heated lanes.

services.title: Elite 1-on-1 Competition Preparation
services.description: Full competition race simulation, reaction dive off starting blocks, dolphin kicks, and split timing.
